adapterWarnings: interval ('+N') heightening text is not a pure damage bump — kept as a description appendix only, not structurally represented

description.value:
You conjure an anvil of pure compressed gravity and slam it down on a single target you can see within range.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 5d10 force damage.

Failure The creature takes 10d10 force damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes 20d10 force damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn (it can't use actions, reactions, or free actions). At the end of its turn, it may attempt another Fortitude save; on a success the incapacitation ends.

Heightened (+1) The damage on a failure increases by 1d10 (and the success damage by half that, and crit-fail damage doubles accordingly).
